universities.name: École Polytechnique (Institut Polytechnique de Paris), Bachelor of Science

programmes_english.name: Bachelor of Science, 3 years, 180 ECTS: double major Mathematics and Computer Science (alternatives: Mathematics and Physics, Mathematics and Economics)

universities.teaching_language_bachelor: English (Bachelor of Science is taught entirely in English)
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE/ISC are not named. A recognised school-leaving certificate (completed or in progress) with advanced mathematics, at least one advanced science subject and a strong overall average. The FAQ says all curricula may be relevant on that basis.

tests.sat: Not listed as a requirement on the pages checked
tests.jee: Not mentioned on official pages checked
tests.other_exam: No separate entrance test listed on the admissions criteria page
tests.interview: Shortlisted candidates only; remote videoconference, about 50 minutes, in English
tests.ielts_min: 6.5 overall, minimum 6 in each skill (result less than two years old on entry)
tests.toefl_min: TOEFL iBT 90 (as published; new-scale equivalent not stated)
tests.local_language_requirement: No French needed to apply; students below CEFR B2 must take French classes and B2 is a graduation requirement

universities.other_requirements: Apply either through the school's own portal or Parcoursup, once per academic year. Applications made through Campus France are not examined and Campus France pre-registration is stated as not needed for the application (visa procedure not verified). English exemption possible at the committee's discretion.

application.deadlines_text: Round 1: 17 Sep to 20 Oct 2026, 23:59 CEST (closed). Round 2: 21 Oct 2026 to 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET. Round 3: 7 Jan to 8 Feb 2027, 14:00 CET.

tuition_non_eu.academic_year: 2027 intake (as stated in the FAQ); rates subject to change

universities.other_fees: CVEC EUR 91 per year; student association (L'ORE) EUR 192 per year; two EUR 1,500 tuition deposits deducted from first-year fees (seen in official-domain search result).

living_cost.amount_text: About EUR 12,000 per year (the living-costs page text indicates this includes housing, food, phone, clothing and miscellaneous); meals EUR 250-350 per month; miscellaneous EUR 150-300 per month

scholarships.name: International Olympiad Medalist Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Tuition waiver plus living allowance, up to EUR 87,900 per year for non-EU students; EUR 1,500 annual administration fee still applies
scholarships.who: Admitted students with an international subject Olympiad medal from the two years before enrolment

scholarships.name: Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.who: Applicants admitted with honours; limited funds

scholarships.name: École Polytechnique / Foundation need-based aid
scholarships.value_text: Tuition waiver and/or interest-free loan covering part of costs
scholarships.who: Students including international students not eligible for the CROUS bursary

hostel.text: On-campus housing guaranteed for all new Bachelor students; single dorm rooms or furnished shared apartments for 4-5. Rent EUR 606 per month (2026 intake, revised annually), not included in tuition; deposit on arrival.

highlights: Three-year Bachelor of Science taught entirely in English with a Mathematics and Computer Science double major
On-campus housing guaranteed for incoming Bachelor students
Third year includes optional study abroad in autumn and an eight-week research internship with thesis
challenges: Non-EU tuition of EUR 19,600 per year plus about EUR 12,000 living costs
Requires advanced mathematics and a further advanced science, with a selective interview
French B2 must be reached to graduate
universities.climate_note: Paris region: mild summers and cool, damp, grey winters.
universities.notes: Rankings are for the parent Institut Polytechnique de Paris, not the school or programme; read from search results (one QS list page showed 45). A student job is described as not possible given the workload. A graduate outcomes report is linked from the programme page but was not read, so employability is null. Alumni not verified. Coordinates and climate note are from general knowledge, not official pages.

universities.name: Politecnico di Milano

programmes_english.name: Engineering Science (Milano Leonardo / Bovisa), new from 2026/27
Civil Engineering, ENG track (Milano Leonardo); 2026/27: 110 places, 60 for non-EU

universities.teaching_language_bachelor: Mostly Italian; a small number of engineering programmes/tracks in English. No fully English bachelor in Computer Engineering was found.
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE/ISC are not named. Secondary qualification after at least 12 or 13 years of schooling (shorter backgrounds need university exams or a foundation year), plus an accepted admission test.

tests.sat: SAT accepted as an alternative to the TOL; converted to a score out of 100 by Politecnico (admission minimum 30/100 on the TOL scale). No raw SAT cut-off verified.
tests.jee: Not listed among accepted tests (TOL, TOLC-I, CEnT-S, SAT)
tests.other_exam: Politecnico TOL (online) or CISIA TOLC-I (Italian), CEnT-S (English) or SAT
tests.local_language_requirement: English-taught: English proof required before enrolment; Italian not required for admission but an Italian additional obligation (B2 certificate or free course) must be cleared before graduating. Italian-taught: Italian B2 required before enrolment.

universities.other_requirements: Non-EU applicants resident abroad compete for reserved places and must pre-enrol for the study visa on Universitaly under the Ministry circular.

application.deadlines_text: 2027/28 phase dates not verified. The 2026/27 call said a separate early-enrolment announcement for 2027/28 would follow by February 2027 for candidates who qualified early.

universities.other_fees: Total ranges from EUR 157.04 (ISEE up to EUR 22,000) to EUR 3,943.04; first instalment shown as EUR 880.04 (a regulation document appears to show 890.04). Students without an ISEE pay the maximum.

living_cost.amount_text: Per month: accommodation EUR 400-700; food 150-200; social 100-200; travel 20-30; phone 10-30

scholarships.name: DSU (right to study) scholarship and residence benefits
scholarships.value_text: Amount not verified; need and merit based, yearly call

scholarships.name: Percorsi di Eccellenza (Cremona campus)
scholarships.value_text: 5 scholarships of EUR 5,000 each (year not verified)
scholarships.who: Italian and international bachelor students in listed Cremona programmes including Process Engineering, at least 90/100 in high school diploma

hostel.text: University residences exist with limited places; room cost within about EUR 400-700 per month. Allocation is not guaranteed on any page checked.

placement_employability.text: Italian bachelor graduates who did not continue at Politecnico: 93% employed one year after graduation; 97% after five years (published 7 July 2026). Not specific to international students.

highlights: QS 2027 rank 87, first in Italy
Tuition for 2026/27 capped at EUR 3,943.04 per year
Accepts SAT or CEnT-S in English as alternatives to its own test
challenges: Few English-taught bachelor options and no verified English computer engineering bachelor
Italian language obligation even on English programmes
Universitaly pre-enrolment, visa and reserved-place ranking; 2027/28 dates not yet verified
universities.climate_note: Milan has hot, humid summers and cold, often foggy winters.
universities.notes: Admission rules are from the 2026/27 call; the 2027/28 call was not found. The automatic top fee bracket for non-EU students resident abroad was seen in a Polimi 2025/26 fee document and search summary; the 2026/27 web page states it explicitly only for certain Master's students. Merit-based international scholarships found were described for Master's students. Coordinates and climate note are from general knowledge.

universities.name: University of Bologna
universities.teaching_language_bachelor: Italian for all engineering and computer science bachelor degrees listed by the DEI and DISI departments. Statistical Sciences is listed as 'English, Italian' (curriculum languages not stated). Some non-engineering bachelors (e.g. Economics and Finance) are in English.
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE/ISC are not named. First-cycle entry needs a secondary qualification after at least 12 years of schooling (official-domain search result) plus programme access test; check the programme call.

tests.sat: Some restricted-access programmes use SAT or other English tests; engineering/CS in Italian use TOLC (Computer Engineering: TOLC-I)
tests.jee: Not mentioned on official pages checked
tests.other_exam: TOLC-I for Computer Engineering; TOLC-E for Statistical Sciences
tests.local_language_requirement: Italian required for Italian-taught degrees (online test, recognised certificate or Italian qualification); embassies may ask for at least CEFR B2

universities.other_requirements: Universitaly pre-enrolment (one programme); unconditional validation needed for the visa; pre-enrolment does not guarantee admission. Reserved places for non-EU citizens resident abroad. Minimum visa funds quoted for 2026: EUR 10,179.85.

application.deadlines_text: 2027/28 calls not yet found. For 2026/27, documents for the upload route were due by 21 July 2026 (last cycle, for reference only).

tuition_non_eu.per: year (reduced flat fee, non-OECD category: EUR 1,000 + EUR 157.04, freshers, if eligible)

universities.other_fees: Fixed first instalment EUR 157.04 (regional tax, stamp duty, insurance). Particularly poor/developing country list: EUR 500 + 157.04. Maximum fee not verified from the current table (a search summary cited EUR 6,000 for non-EU students). Health service registration about EUR 700 per year.

living_cost.amount_text: Single room in shared flat about EUR 400 per month plus utilities; shared room about EUR 300; groceries about EUR 60 per week

scholarships.name: ER.GO regional study grant, housing and meal benefits
scholarships.value_text: Amount not verified; 2026/27 income limits ISEE EUR 25,000 and ISPE EUR 50,000
scholarships.who: Eligible students including non-EU with legalised family income documents

hostel.text: ER.GO residences for eligible students; the university's SAIS service helps find residences or private rentals. No guaranteed housing found.

highlights: QS 2027 rank 123 and THE 2027 rank 111, first in Italy in THE
Reduced flat fees exist for eligible non-OECD nationals with family income abroad
Computer engineering and computer science bachelors are available in Italian
challenges: No fully English engineering or computer science bachelor verified
Italian proficiency (visa may require B2) and TOLC test for Italian programmes
Visa pre-enrolment timing and private rental search
universities.climate_note: Bologna has hot, humid summers and cold, foggy winters.
universities.notes: The English-bachelor check covered the DEI, DISI and Statistics department listings and searches, not every department or campus. Whether India falls in the 'non-OECD' or 'particularly poor/developing' list must be checked in the official country lists; the reduced fee depends on citizenship and family income/assets position, so NRI families should confirm eligibility. The tuition amount shown is not the standard maximum. Coordinates (central Bologna) and climate note are from general knowledge.

universities.name: IE University

programmes_english.name: Bachelor in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence (4 years, Segovia or Madrid)
Bachelor in Data and Business Analytics
Dual degree Business Administration + Computer Science and AI (5 years)

universities.eligibility_cbse: Senior Secondary / Central Board diploma with at least 80% overall average. Transcripts for three upper secondary years and diploma, verified, legalised and translated for Spanish legal access. Science and Technology programmes expect strong mathematics (700 SAT Math if SAT is submitted).

tests.sat: Optional alternative to the IE test; recommended 1300 or above; Science and Technology: at least 700 in Math if submitting SAT
tests.jee: Not mentioned on official pages checked
tests.other_exam: IE University Admissions Test (verbal, logical, numerical, plus mathematics assessment for this programme), or SAT/ACT; online assessment with video and written questions
tests.interview: Selected candidates may be invited (online or in person)
tests.local_language_requirement: No Spanish requirement stated on pages checked

universities.other_requirements: CV, one recommendation letter, personal expression; transcripts from the last two completed years plus current grades. Spanish Ministry legal-access recognition of the Indian certificate is the student's responsibility. Documents for India per the freshmen page: due to IE Admissions by post or in person before 15 October.

application.closes: Rolling; Round 3 deadline 5 March 2027, later applications from May 2027 subject to places
application.deadlines_text: 2027-28: Early 18 Sep 2026 and Round 1 6 Nov 2026 (passed); Round 2 15 Jan 2027 (decision 19 Feb); Round 3 5 Mar 2027 (decision 23 Apr).

universities.other_fees: Place reservation fee EUR 3,000 (non-refundable, deducted from first year); IE Foundation contribution EUR 1,200 one-time; EUR 455 per ECTS. Dual degree with Business Administration: EUR 34,020 per year (2027-2028).

living_cost.amount_text: Segovia: shared-flat room EUR 400-1,000 per month; private residence room EUR 900-2,000; one-bedroom flat EUR 1,000-1,100; groceries EUR 200-400 (year of sheet not verified). Madrid figures not verified.

scholarships.name: IE Awards (merit and need)
scholarships.value_text: 10-60% of tuition; deadline is programme start date

scholarships.name: IE Foundation scholarships
scholarships.value_text: Up to 100% of tuition and living expenses in some cases
scholarships.who: Admitted candidates meeting each scholarship's criteria

hostel.text: Reyes Católicos residence hall in Segovia (43 single rooms); fees committed for the full academic year; not guaranteed on pages checked.

placement_employability.text: IE reports 95% employability within six months (2024), self-reported, institution-wide.

highlights: English-taught computer science, AI and data bachelors
Rolling admissions in rounds with own test or SAT
Merit and need-based awards available to international admits
challenges: High tuition (EUR 27,300 per year) plus reservation and foundation fees
IELTS 7.0 and 80% CBSE average
Legalisation of Indian documents for Spanish access
universities.climate_note: Segovia and Madrid have hot dry summers and cold winters, with Segovia colder because of its altitude.
universities.notes: TOEFL institution code differs between official pages (3032 on freshmen page, 5522 in the 2027-28 policy): confirm before sending scores. English exemption possible for English-system schooling (at least last two years). A later IE item cited 96% employment (2025 report) but its URL was not pinned down. THE overall rank not found. QS rank from a topuniversities profile seen in search. Alumni not verified. Coordinates are Segovia, from general knowledge, as is the climate note.

universities.name: Aalto University
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE/ISC are not named; upper secondary completed outside Finland that gives university eligibility in that country applies in admission round A on SAT or ACT results. 2027 intake places in round A include Computer Engineering 22 and Data Science 19.

tests.sat: Science and Technology: total at least 1350 AND Math at least 700 (or ACT 29 and Math 30); tests from 1 January 2025; official scores must reach Aalto by 29 January 2027
tests.jee: Not mentioned on official pages checked
tests.other_exam: None for these programmes beyond SAT/ACT
tests.interview: None mentioned for science and technology
tests.ielts_min: No English test required for this route
tests.toefl_min: No English test required for this route
tests.local_language_requirement: No Finnish requirement mentioned; applicants expected to be able to study in English

universities.other_requirements: Apply through Studyinfo; send score report and College Board ID. Residence permit rules not checked.

application.deadlines_text: Apply 7-22 January 2027; SAT/ACT scores and documents by 29 January 2027 23:59 (UTC+2); results by 14 April 2027; accept by 13 July 2027.
application.application_fee: EUR 100 (non-EU/EEA/Swiss), within seven days of applying, no waivers

tuition_non_eu.academic_year: study rights from 1 August 2025 onwards; no separate 2027 figure; subject to change

universities.other_fees: Early-bird: 25% reduction on first-year tuition for binding acceptance and payment within 21 days.

scholarships.name: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Merit-based tuition fee waiver for the normative study time; no living costs; very limited number
scholarships.who: Fee-paying applicants; apply within the admission form

hostel.text: Aalto does not itself provide housing and it is not guaranteed; students apply to AYY, HOAS and the private market. About EUR 400-600 per month in student housing (Aalto fact sheet).

placement_employability.text: School of Engineering: 97% employed or self-employed (2025 survey of 2020 graduates; graduate survey, not bachelor-only).

highlights: Six English-taught engineering and data bachelors
Admission for foreign school diplomas is on SAT/ACT with published minimums and no English test
Merit tuition waiver and 25% first-year early-bird discount
challenges: High bar: SAT 1350 with Math 700 is only the minimum; places are few
Short application window of 7-22 January 2027
Housing not guaranteed; cold dark winters
universities.climate_note: Cold, snowy and dark winters with mild summers and very long summer days.
universities.notes: Employability, rent range, housing and alumni details come from official-domain search summaries rather than direct page reads; verify before publishing. Coordinates and climate note are from general knowledge.

universities.name: KTH Royal Institute of Technology

programmes_english.name: BSc Information and Communication Technology (3 years, 180 ECTS)

universities.teaching_language_bachelor: English for BSc ICT, the only English bachelor identified; other bachelor-level engineering study is understood to be in Swedish (not separately verified)
universities.eligibility_cbse: Class 12 certificate (AISSCE, ISC and others) with board statement of marks; school-issued certificates and DigiLocker-style digital signatures not accepted. Mathematics and Physics at Swedish Mathematics 4 and Physics 2 level with passing grades. English met by CBSE (2008 onwards) or ISC Class XII English grade, or an approved test. No conditional admission on predicted grades.

tests.sat: Not mentioned; selection is on upper secondary grades only
tests.jee: Not mentioned on official pages checked
tests.interview: None mentioned; motivation and recommendation letters are not considered
tests.ielts_min: 6.5 overall, no section below 5.5 (if a test is used)
tests.toefl_min: Before 21 Jan 2026: 90 with writing 20; from 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 with no section below 4
tests.local_language_requirement: No Swedish requirement stated for ICT

universities.other_requirements: Apply through University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se); upload stamped and signed documents and passport. Residence permit needed; first round recommended for non-EU applicants.

application.deadlines_text: Autumn 2027 Round 1: apply 16 Oct 2026 to 15 Jan 2027; documents and fee by 1 Feb; results 8 April. Round 2 (15 Mar to 15 Apr) is mainly for EU/EEA/Swiss applicants.

universities.other_fees: Tuition charged in advance each semester; housing not included.

living_cost.amount_text: SEK 10,584-14,950 per month including accommodation and food (2026-27 exchange student brochure)

hostel.text: Fee-paying full-programme students are guaranteed accommodation through KTH Housing for the first academic year only, subject to conditions; rent extra.

placement_employability.text: KTH states 97% of 2016-2018 graduates have been in employment since finishing (institution-wide, older cohorts).

alumni.name: Karin Rådström (CEO Daimler Truck; Master's, Alum of the Year 2025)
Christer Fuglesang (ESA astronaut; Alum of the Year 2012)
Gustav Söderström (Spotify; Alum of the Year 2019)
Bolle Tham and Martin Videgård (architects; Alum of the Year 2026)

highlights: QS 2027 rank 82
No entrance test; selection purely on school grades
First-year housing guarantee for fee-paying students
challenges: Only one English bachelor, with about 10% admitted in 2024 (71 of 684 eligible)
No bachelor scholarships; SEK 453,000 tuition
Application closes 15 January 2027, before Class 12 results, and no predicted-grade conditional offers
universities.climate_note: Cold, dark winters and mild summers with long daylight.
universities.notes: How a current Class 12 student meets the 1 February document deadline is not explained on pages checked; because conditional admission is not offered, confirm with KTH / University Admissions whether 2027 Class 12 candidates can compete in time. NRI students on Gulf boards or schools should check the country instructions for the issuing country. Alumni, living cost, housing and employability were read from official-domain search summaries; Spotify role of Söderström is from general context of the summary and should be confirmed. Coordinates and climate note are from general knowledge.

universities.name: Technical University of Denmark (DTU)
universities.teaching_language_bachelor: Danish, except the BSc in General Engineering, which is taught in English
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE/ISC are not named. Qualification equivalent to a Danish upper secondary exam, with Mathematics A, Physics B, Chemistry B and English B levels; DTU assesses levels (pre-assessment can be requested 1 September to 1 November); supplementary courses needed if a level is missing.

tests.jee: Not mentioned on official pages checked
tests.other_exam: No entrance test mentioned on pages checked; quota 2 assessment details not checked
tests.ielts_min: 6.5 (Academic); required for Indian applicants even if schooled in English
tests.toefl_min: 88, or 4.5 for tests after 21 January (DTU code 1684)
tests.local_language_requirement: No Danish required for this English programme (none listed)

universities.other_requirements: Apply on optagelse.dk; send signed signature page by 15 March if no Danish CPR number; non-Nordic-language documents need authorised English translation; statement of hours form.

application.deadlines_text: Portal opens 1 February; non-EU application, signature page and fee due 15 March noon; quota 2 documentation by 1 April; offers 28 July; accept by 3 August. The page does not state the year on most dates.
application.application_fee: EUR 100 (non-EU/EEA), deducted from first tuition payment

universities.other_fees: Autumn tuition due 1 August, spring 1 January.

living_cost.amount_text: No current official figure verified. An older DTU information package cites DKK 6,000-9,600 per month (2013-era exchange rate), so treat as outdated.

hostel.text: International students can apply to Boligfonden DTU (BDTU), mostly at Lyngby campus; no guarantee stated; DTU warns housing can be expensive and of rental scams.

placement_employability.text: Almost 9 in 10 DTU MSc and BEng graduates (2019-2021 cohorts) employed within one year; Epinion survey published August 2022. Does not cover the General Engineering BSc.

highlights: QS 2027 rank 105 and THE 2027 rank 110
Broad three-year General Engineering BSc taught in English
Published subject-level and English requirements
challenges: Only one English bachelor; physics, chemistry and maths A-level equivalence needed
No undergraduate scholarships or fee waivers
Results come on 28 July, leaving little time for residence permit and housing
universities.climate_note: Cool, windy and often grey winters with mild summers.
universities.notes: Deadlines page has inconsistent year references; confirm 2027 dates. Whether CBSE/ISC Class 12 meets A-level mathematics is decided by DTU. Alumni not verified. Coordinates and climate note are from general knowledge.
